steps.eval: (async()=>{const T={phase:()=>window.__TEST__.phase(),step:()=>window.__TEST__.step(),question:()=>window.__TEST__.question(),prediction:()=>window.__TEST__.prediction()};const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const stop=window.__STOP;const btn=re=>[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(b=>re.test(b.textContent.trim())&&!b.disabled);const answer=async q=>{if(q.input==="number"){const i=document.querySelector("#answer-number");const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,"value").set;set.call(i,String(q.answer));i.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));await sleep(80);i.form.requestSubmit()}else document.querySelector(`[data-value="${q.answer}"]`).click()};const log=[];for(let g=0;g<300&&T.phase()!=="result";g++){if(stop&&T.phase()==="steps"&&T.step().index===stop)return {stopped:stop,log};if(T.phase()==="check"){if(!document.querySelector("[role=status]")){await answer(T.question());await sleep(300)}const n=btn(/^(Siguiente|Ver resultados)/);if(n){n.click();await sleep(400)}continue}const s=T.step();const next=btn(/^(Siguiente|Empezar el repaso)/);if(next){log.push(s.kind);next.click();await sleep(600);continue}if(s.kind==="predict"&&!document.querySelector("[role=status]")){await answer(T.prediction());await sleep(2700);continue}if(s.kind==="task"){const sh=btn(/Shipping lee el siguiente/);if(sh){sh.click();await sleep(550);continue}if(btn(/→ orders/)){btn(/Nuevo pedido/.test(document.body.innerText)?/→ orders/:/→ payments/).click();await sleep(450);continue}const d=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(b=>b.textContent.includes("dave"));if(d){d.click();await sleep(900);continue}}await sleep(500)}return {phase:T.phase(),log}})()
